headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Monetary Policy Committee Convenes Rate Meeting
summary: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Central Bank of Nigeria began its two-day meeting to evaluate domestic economic conditions and decide on benchmark interest rate adjustments.
why: Central Bank of Nigeria interest rate decisions guide money supply, commercial bank lending costs, and foreign exchange stability in Africa's most populous nation.

impacts.name: Nigeria Policy Rate
impacts.why: The monetary policy committee meeting determines benchmark interest rates across the banking sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
